multibagger_500_error.root_cause: yfinance info.get('debtToEquity'), info.get('currentRatio'), info.get('returnOnEquity') can return Python float NaN when Yahoo Finance returns null/undefined for these metrics. Python json.dumps raises ValueError for NaN/Inf. FastAPI uses json.dumps under the hood, so the response serialization fails.
multibagger_500_error.reproduction_steps: GET /api/multibagger/candidates - fails on symbols where yfinance returns NaN for financial metrics
multibagger_500_error.mitigation: Added _sanitize_float() helper that returns None for NaN/Inf values. Applied throughout _fetch_yfinance_fundamentals(). Added NaN guard in _compute_beneish_m_score_from_data() _get() helper. Added model_validator to MultibaggerCandidate as defense-in-depth.

best_exit_days_missing.root_cause: CustomPositionResponse Pydantic model (line 518) does not include best_exit_days field. The DB document never stores best_exit_days. _refresh_open_position calculates logic but never sets best_exit_days.
best_exit_days_missing.reproduction_steps: Create a custom position, then check custom position card - BEST EXIT shows 'T+? @ ₹X.XX'
best_exit_days_missing.mitigation: Add best_exit_days: int | None = None to CustomPositionResponse. Calculate days_to_expiry/minutes_to_expiry based best_exit_days in _refresh_open_position and store in DB. Return it in _position_to_response.
